new.statement: Grow-a-garden games (plant seeds, water, harvest income) rank lower on Up-and-Coming than other games of the same age
Young games with a video in their page media climb Top Trending faster than games of similar age without one
new.action: Add a gameplay video to the page

new.statement: Descriptions shorter than about 700 characters go with higher Up-and-Coming positions among games of the same age
Job sims built around one satisfying, ASMR-style craft verb (tufting and shaving rugs, washing cars, peeling potatoes) break out on Up-and-Coming and some carry on to Most Popular
new.action: Build around one satisfying craft verb
new.rationale: Make Rugs! entered Up-and-Coming at 12 days with 95% likes and close-up 'satisfying' thumbnails, and Wash the Car rose 38 places on Most Popular at 64 days; but Peel THE Potato fell off Top Trending and Paint a Pancake fell 41 on Up-and-Coming, so the verb alone is not enough. A craft-verb feature from the profiles would test it.

qualitative_updates.note: A third round-based makeup game, Makeup All Stars (themed beauty battles with voting), entered Up-and-Coming at 15 days; Facecard: Makeup Showdown rose 35 on Most Popular and Makeup Salon rose 22 on Top Trending. The rated-round versions keep outperforming the solo ones.

Backseat Rally is among the best on Up-and-Coming and newly on Top Trending at 14 days, but Rally Panic! is among the weakest Top Trending movers and Scooter Duo fell off Up-and-Coming; the wave holds but is not lifting every entrant.
Escooter Life climbed 162 places on Top Earning at 8 days and Bike Universe entered Top Trending; Redlane fell off Up-and-Coming.

Steal Animal Egg (-17) and Steal ASMR! (-19) fell on Most Popular, Clone to Steal Eggs fell 118 on Top Earning and Bike For Egg is among the weakest on Most Popular, while Steal An Egg still leads; Kick a Lucky Block (+42) is the exception.

Anomaly-spotting keeps spreading: Clone Baby Care (Anomaly) rose 54 on Up-and-Coming at 10 days, Sell Fries! [Anomaly] is among the best on Up-and-Coming, and Route Zero wraps anomaly spotting in a bus route on Top Trending.
uc→tt (70, median 2 days) now edges tt→mp (69, 2 days); the order of the sequence holds.

retire.reason: The page-video association with Top Trending momentum has turned positive (r=+0.37, within-age +0.35); replaced by the opposite hypothesis so the action can follow the data.
